hotels.title: Stylish Wagga Wagga Escape in the Heart of the Riverina
hotels.description: Set in a quiet pocket of central Wagga Wagga, this contemporary retreat places you close to the Murrumbidgee River, the Botanic Gardens and the National Art Glass Gallery. Spacious rooms are paired with a heated outdoor pool, leafy courtyard and an onsite restaurant serving modern Australian fare. Beyond the hotel, stroll to Fitzmaurice Street for polished wine bars and easy dinners, or visit the Wagga Wagga Art Gallery for its celebrated National Art Glass Collection. A short drive leads to the Riverina’s cellar doors, including Borambola Wines, where local shiraz and house-made produce take centre stage
